name: Birdwatcher Elsa

intro.text: Quiet! A bittern booms in spring. It sounds like somebody blowing across a bottle, a mile off. Marvellous. Now hush.

win: That's every bittern for a mile gone. Oh well. I'll count the pigeons.
after: Bitterns nearly died out in Britain in the 1990s. They have come back, and I like to think we deserve some of the credit.
